verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for an email API service like Mailgun, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API version identifiers, version lifecycles or a deprecation policy. The API overview, SDK and Postman items describe API availability and regions only, and do not count toward versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
